purpose: correctness repair hypothesis: fixed-prompt private decoder recovery after preemption
intended_invariants: Accepted generated rows remain part of the original request after private decoder/drafter state is discarded.
Prefix reuse cannot skip the original prompt replay floor or the accepted output history needed by deeper decoder layers.
Ordinary prompt/decode policy is retained; additional recovery work is intentional.
Actual streaming-input sessions retain their previous behavior, including after the final input sentinel; durable streaming_queue identity is carried to the worker.
Group eviction, request cancellation/freeing, reordering and slot reuse cannot substitute another request's private history.

provided_evidence.classification: PR-provided results, not independently executed or raw-audited here
limits: These overlapping and historical counts are not additive independent trials.
The six control failures establish a CPU recovery-boundary policy difference; they are not an observed old-fails/new-passes native decoder or checkpoint result.
The mathematical and streaming-phase models are explicitly non-native. HiSparse platform/import failures remain unqualified rather than passes or candidate regressions.
The proposed native three-layer witness fixes encoder rows and does not execute actual DSpark context projection/storage, the complete checkpoint or all private-state reconstruction. It has not run.
Full-model outputs/logprobs, cancellation/preemption, native old-fails/new-passes and boot/repeat performance preservation remain pending.

runtime_source_review.finding: No concrete new defect in the fixed-prompt replay-floor or durable streaming-input scope was confirmed by this limited source review. Native and checkpoint correctness are unresolved.
runtime_source_review.source_base_limit: The proposal is C38-based. Eventual adoption must preserve the validated default-enabled corrected C40 base rather than replace it with this C38 lock/profile.

focused_control_rework.issue: A RuntimeError from the initial live doctor or restoration snapshot is swallowed as merely not-already-restored. A transient management-path failure can therefore be followed by stop/sync/start after a later probe recovers; there is no sticky management/telemetry-loss veto.
focused_control_rework.minimum_fix: Distinguish ordinary candidate/live mismatch from management or telemetry loss, persist the latter in the exact owned hold, and forbid restoration launch after it. Do not clear the latch on recovery. Propagate guard-loss evidence from guarded_probe.py rather than only saving it in conditions.json.
focused_control_rework.regression_needed: A transient management or guard-telemetry failure followed by successful reads must retain a review hold and issue no restoration mutation.

focused_control_rework.issue: Unresolved build/probe activity markers are checked only after possible stop/sync/start. The code explicitly anticipates a crashed coordinator leaving a child alive, but the late check protects hold removal only, not the live child's runtime/source from restoration changes.
focused_control_rework.minimum_fix: Before any restoration mutation, establish that owned source/GPU/probe jobs have exited. If unresolved, retain the exact hold and defer; terminate only an independently identified owned job when permitted, then verify its exit before proceeding.
focused_control_rework.regression_needed: An active or unresolved owned-job marker must cause no stop, sync or start, not merely prevent final hold release.

focused_control_rework.issue: The last own() check precedes the final remote snapshot. A foreign replacement arriving during that snapshot or subsequent marker inspection can be unlinked at hold_path.unlink(). The private operation lock does not bind unrelated hold writers.
focused_control_rework.minimum_fix: Revalidate the exact holder/window and any owner token immediately before release, under the ownership mutation discipline, preserving a foreign replacement. Reuse the already reviewed exact-lifecycle approach rather than a broad watchdog path.
focused_control_rework.regression_needed: Replace the hold during final verification and require its bytes to remain unchanged with no release or foreign-process action.

positive_controls: Window checks compare the exact recorded holder and window rather than granting authority from a broad holder prefix.
All-rank restoration snapshots require original clean checkouts, image ID/tag, profile, origin and API readiness, beyond doctor --live alone.
The source verifier distinguishes the immutable parent OCI image from four candidate Python overlays, hashes those files on all ranks and requires the candidate mounts to be read-only.
The runbook preserves earlier Engram and expert-routing reservations and does not start an acquisition waiter.
ownership_and_overlay_review.limits: These are source-reviewed controls and an unexecuted plan. No overlay was adopted, serving source loaded, reservation reconciled or restoration independently observed in this review.

disposition: Retain the unique correctness investigation. Focused execution-control rework is required before its hardware run; the unbuilt runtime idea is not rejected. Preserve all earlier failures and native gaps, then qualify the affected path and ordinary performance preservation.
serving_performance: unmeasured, not neutral; extra recovery work is expected and must be reported separately
review_scope: Lightweight primary source/diff, runbook and provided small-summary review only
